help.name: mri_warp_convert
help.description: This program converts non-linear deformation warp fields between different file formats. Some formats may require you to pass an image if the geometry information is missing from the transform file.

required-flagged.explanation: input Freesurfer 3D morph, support m3z (deprecated), mgz, and nifti NIFTI_INTENT_DISPVECT file formats
input FSL warp (recommend to use with --insrcgeom)
input SPM warp (use with --insrcgeom). Use --in-interp <> to specify the data interpretation, which is either abs-ras (default) or abs-crs.)
input LPS-to-LPS displacement field (e.g. ITK, ANTs)
input displacement field in source-voxel space
output Freesurfer 3D morph, support m3z (deprecated), mgz, and nifti NIFTI_INTENT_DISPVECT file formats
output LPS-to-LPS displacement field (e.g. ITK, ANTs)
output displacement field in source-voxel space

optional-flagged.explanation: Specify volume geometry of the input to the warp space, i.e., srcgeom shares an RAS space with the warp volume. Usually this is identical to the geom of the warp volume itself (if the warp input is in a format that has such info). This also allows the input to the warp to have a different geometry than the warp itself, though this is probably better handled with -lta1.
Downsample output M3Z to spacing of 2.
Create composite morph for warping a source image -> LTA1 -> GCAM -> LTA2 -> atlas/destination image
Create composite morph for warping a source image -> LTA1 -> GCAM -> LTA2 -> atlas/destination image
specify warp data interpretation: abs-crs, disp-crs, abs-ras, or disp-ras (default is abs-crs). This option only works with '--inspm <out.mgz>'.
specify warp data interpretation: abs-crs, disp-crs, abs-ras, or disp-ras (default is abs-crs)
specify threshold for testing diffs in volume geom

help.example: Convert FSL warp to M3Z (FreeSurfer): mri_warp_convert --infsl fsl.nii.gz --outfswarp out.m3z --insrcgeom src.nii.gz
Convert ITK warp (e.g. ANTs) to M3Z (FreeSurfer): mri_warp_convert --initk itk.nii.gz --outfswarp out.m3z --insrcgeom src.nii.gz

Convert ANTS antsRegistrationSyN.sh or antsRegistrationSyNQuick.sh output to M3Z (FreeSurfer): antsRegistrationSyNQuick.sh -d 3 -m mov.mgz -f targ.mgz -o reg. ConvertTransformFile 3 ants.reg0GenericAffine.mat ants.reg0GenericAffine.txt --hm --ras lta_convert --src mov.mgz --trg targ.mgz --inniftyreg ants.reg0GenericAffine.txt --outlta ants.reg0GenericAffine.lta mri_warp_convert --lta1-inv ants.reg0GenericAffine.lta --initk ants.reg1Warp.nii.gz --outfswarp out.m3z --insrcgeom targ.mgz Note that the insrcgeom is the target, not the mov; this is needed to work with --lta1-inv.
Convert M3Z (FreeSurfer) to ITK warp (e.g. ANTs): mri_warp_convert --infswarp in.m3z --outitk out.nii.gz
Convert M3Z (FreeSurfer) to mgz warp (FreeSurfer) in absolute CRS: mri_warp_convert --infswarp in.m3z --outfswarp outwarp.mgz --out-interp abs-crs
help.see-also: mri_convert -at or -ait (apply transforms to an image) lta_convert (convert between different linear transform formats) mri_concatenate_lta (concatenate or invert LTA transforms) mri_concatenate_gcam (concatenate or invert warp fields)
